Hi Marissa — thanks for the recap. A few clarifications from our side:

- KMS: this must be HSM-backed keys (FIPS 140-2 level) and keys must be under our control. Envelope encryption with CMKs is acceptable only if the root keys are HSM-backed and we retain the key material control (BYOK).
- Logging: our compliance requires 10-year retention for request/audit logs for certain workflows; logs must be exportable to our S3 in us-east-1 and also we push to Splunk for realtime alerts.
- Network: we would prefer VPC peering or PrivateLink to avoid public egress, but we also want to understand whether Dedicated can offer an isolated network path without fully private control plane.

We are open to evaluating Dedicated if it can meet the KMS+networking+logging requirements; otherwise Private VPC/on-prem is required. Please have your engineering team confirm the exact capabilities and limitations.

Hi Alex — thanks for the clarifications and availability. Short answers below from our infra team; I've kept this high-level and attached a more detailed appendix. Happy to walk through on Wed Jul 29 at 09:30 PT (confirming your morning availability).

1) KMS / HSM:
- Dedicated: supports envelope encryption with customer-managed CMKs (BYOK) using KMS providers. For HSM-backed root keys, we integrate with common cloud HSMs (AWS CloudHSM) for customer-controlled key material; however, for full FIPS HSM isolation and customer-managed hardware appliances, Private (VPC or on-prem) is the recommended path.
- Private: supports direct integration with customer HSM appliances and gives you full control over key lifecycle.

2) Logging & retention:
- Hosted (default): 90-day retention.
- Dedicated: can export all request/audit logs to a customer-owned S3 bucket in us-east-1; customers can apply lifecycle policies for 10-year retention/archival. We also support log forwarding to your SIEM (Splunk) via our log-stream connector (near-realtime).
- Private: full control over log storage and retention on your side.

3) Networking:
- Dedicated: supports VPC peering and PrivateLink for private connectivity; control plane is still hosted but network egress can be locked down. This typically satisfies customers who need private networking without full Private deployment.
- Private: private control plane option or on-prem deployments eliminate hosted control plane exposure.

Recommendation: based on the three constraints (HSM-backed BYOK + 10-year retention + Splunk export), Dedicated with VPC peering + customer-managed CloudHSM is likely sufficient for compliance in many cases and is faster to stand up. If FinTechCo requires physical HSM appliances or full in-region on-prem control of both keys and control plane, Private is the path.
